script: Stop saying "you're beautiful." Here are three psychological compliments she won't stop thinking about. "Beautiful" is the beginner's compliment. It makes you one more fan in her inbox. Want her to see real interest? Use one of these. Number one: "I was gonna say you look great today, but first, you look like the bad influence of your friend group." That intrigues her. It skips her looks for a second, and goes straight to her personality, and she feels the need to explain herself. Number two: "You're dangerously attractive, but I have a feeling, dating you is an extreme sport." You gave her a compliment and a challenge at the same time. Now she wants to prove you wrong. Number three, my favorite: "You look like an angel, but I bet deep down you're trouble." It speaks to her playful side. She'll ask why you said it. Now comment the word ANGEL, and I'll send you the exact messages.
